Definitions. Section 3. Act not to apply to certain inams and grants. Section 4. Abolition of personal inams and rights in respect of such inams. Section 5. Liability of inam village or inam land to payment of land revenue and inamdar and permanent holder to be occupant. Section 6. Compensation for abolition of cash allowance. Section 7. All public roads, etc., situate in inam villages to vest in Government. Section 8. Right to trees. Section 9. Deleted. Section 10. Compensation to inamdars for extinguishment of rights under section 7. Section 11. Appeal against Collector’s award. Section 12. Procedure before Revenue Tribunal. Section 13. Limitation. Section 14. Court-fees. Section 15. Finality of award and decision of Revenue Tribunal. Section 16. Inquiries and proceedings to be judicial proceedings. Section 16A. Method of compensation for extinguishment of certain rights. Section 17. Method of compensation for abolition, etc., of other rights in property. Section 17A. Amount of compensation to be payable in transferable bonds. Section 18. Provisions of Bom. LXVII of 1948 to govern the relations of inamdar and tenants. Section 19. Rules. Section 20.
